Perfect! Now I understand the issue. The catalog-search application takes time to load its index shards (it was loading shard 23/48 when it got terminated). The current configuration has:
- Liveness probe with initialDelaySeconds=30s
- Readiness probe with initialDelaySeconds=0s

The application is taking more than 30 seconds to start (it was on shard 23 out of 48 at the 54-second mark), so the liveness probe begins failing before the app is ready. The probe needs more time, and the app needs a startup probe.

Let me search for more information about pod configuration to understand the full context.
